entries.title: Android build credentials and runtime skeleton
entries.description: Adds fork-specific API credentials from local.properties and the Kotlin/tele runtime skeleton (TeleConfig, TeleHooks, tele.db) that later Android changes build on. This is Android-only build and storage foundation.

entries.title: Android packaging, branding and launcher icons
desktop: new tele app and tray icons
entries.description: Renames the app and fork packages, disables stock Google services, overrides user-visible app names, and ships the Android adaptive launcher, notification and settings icons. The packaging, string overrides and generated icon assets are Android-specific work; the naming and icon feature follows the desktop.

entries.title: Native tele settings, navigation and search
desktop: add a tele section to the settings
entries.description: Builds the Android tele settings tree: section pages, grouped rows, collapsible sub-options, and stock settings-search integration that opens and highlights the matching row. Includes Android-side fixes for search results and rows; the settings architecture is native Android work around the desktop settings feature.

entries.title: Local names and aliases with shared native editors
entries.description: Adds Android editors for per-account local names and usernames: themed inline fields with delete, management screens in tele settings, and one shared alias dialog used by chat and profile menus. The feature follows desktop local names and aliases; the editor flow is native Android.

entries.title: Retained deleted messages, edit history and saved drafts
desktop: keep the edit history of messages
show edit history as a chat
entries.description: Stores kept deleted messages, message edits and draft snapshots in tele.db and adds native screens for drafts and deleted messages. The desktop retention and draft features are reimplemented for Android storage and UI; the Android design is substantial, but the feature concept is not claimed as original.

entries.title: Public tele server, Argon2 and crash bridge
desktop: apply verification and marks from the tele server
show checkmarks and custom verification everywhere
clear server data and explain custom verifications
send crash reports to the tele server
entries.description: Adds the Android client for the public tele server: hashed badge feed, Argon2 helper, server usernames, badge rendering hooks, refresh and clear, and the crash-report upload bridge. It only downloads public data and sends no account data, matching the desktop server feature.

entries.title: Android updater, release notes and local tele chat
desktop: update from the tele github releases
show what's new in tele after an update
show new settings after an update
what's new as a settings page with live toggles
entries.description: Implements the Android in-app updater (APK feed, SHA-256, resume and retry), a local "tele" changelog chat, per-version history and live new-settings toggles. The update flow is Android-specific; the release-notes and what's-new behavior follows the desktop.

entries.title: Message shots and render pipeline
desktop: scale shots up to 4x and show your messages as incoming
entries.description: Renders selected messages into a bitmap on Android with 1x-4x scale, incoming-style own messages, configurable visibility and skipped-message markers; fixes sender and badge rendering and normalizes docked-shot sending. The rendering code is Android-native work around the desktop shot feature.

entries.title: Notification center, presence and service notices
desktop: rate-limit notices for slowmode and download throttling
mentions and replies in the notification centre
reply and mention badges in the notification centre
copied values in the notification centre
entries.description: Adds the on-device notification center and its Android integrations: tgnet flood-wait hook, presence notifications, mention and reply entries, badges, full entries, copied-value logging, tele toasts and server notices. The subsystem is ported, with the JNI hook and Android UI written here.

entries.title: Diagnostics, MTProto tools and memory reports
desktop: send crash reports to the tele server
send crash reports without a dump
entries.description: Adds Android diagnostics: memory data in crash reports, OOM heap snapshots, Java-side MTProto capture and inspection, a schema-driven MTProto console, no-dump and freeze reports, and foreground-only freeze gating. The Android tooling and crash surfaces are native work; capture and console behavior follows the desktop.

entries.title: Wallet engine Android integration
desktop: take wallet-engine from gettele/money for private keys
turn on the wallet before telegram does
entries.description: Builds the Android wallet engine with private-key support, key rotation and backup, import and recovery screens, pasted-word handling and phrase-sheet scrolling. The engine integration and NDK bridge are Android work built on the desktop wallet-engine feature.

entries.title: Android scripting host and native scripting UIs
desktop: let scripts give their menu items icons
entries.description: Adds the QuickJS-ng JNI host, per-account script runtimes, grants and sandboxing, and native Android surfaces for menus, links, notifications, shared files, compose, player, calls, message actions, script text and logs. The host and UI are Android-native implementations of the desktop scripting prototype.

entries.title: Cross-cutting fork security boundaries
entries.description: Hardens fork boundaries that stock Android does not cover: per-account script isolation and approvals, pending-reply ownership, streamer-mode secret windows, last-seen restoration, local-password recovery ownership, and bounded regex, notice and update paths. Android-specific audit work.

entries.title: Docked media composer
desktop: attach media above the field (docked media)
caption docked media and bring it to parity with the send box
entries.description: Implements the Android media composer above the message field: docked photos, video, documents, shots and captioned stickers, per-chat and per-topic drafts, reordering, spoiler previews, drag animation, removal and send integration. The composer is a substantial native Android implementation of the desktop docked-media feature.

entries.title: Round video recording controls
entries.description: Android round-video camera preview, manual start and zoom controls.
